bibl.title: Girolamo Vitelli prima dei papiri.
bibl.seg: Francesco Valerio, Girolamo Vitelli prima dei papiri.
Paola Davoli & Natascia Pellé (edd.), Πολυμάθεια. Studi Classici offerti a Mario Capasso (Lecce, 2018) pp. 925-948.
bibl.note: In the first half of his career (from the 1870s to 1900), Girolamo Vitelli gained great reknown as a classical scholar, active mainly in the fields of textual criticism and Greek palaeography; this paper offers a survey of his scientific output in these areas, in order to re-evaluate the importance of his contribution.
